text.offer: You have served me well enough to be trusted with one of my soldiers. Stand before me and ask for a companion, and one will swear to follow you. Look after them: a soldier who trusts you fights the harder for it.
text.progress: Stand before the Duke and ask him for a companion (the Companion tab, C).
text.complete: Good. Fight beside your soldier, and the bond between you will grow. Keep them close, and keep them alive.

steps.objective: Take a companion into your service
steps.brief: Stand before the Duke and ask him for a companion (the Companion tab, C).
